observed_failure.exception_message: failed checkpoint selected-neuron identity did not reproduce

diagnosis: V310 selected neurons from the fp32 in-memory attention fit but retained the layer checkpoint in fp16. Replaying the fp16 attention state can change borderline importance ordering, so recomputation is not a valid identity mechanism. The immutable sparse gate/up rows themselves still encode the selected source-neuron weights and can be matched read-only against the frozen source tensor.
decision: Close V313 without repair or screening. Authorize one read-only exact fp16 row-identity recovery audit. No nearest-neighbor substitution is allowed: every stored gate/up row pair must have exactly one identical source-neuron row pair after fp16 canonicalization.
claim_boundary: Failed repair precondition only; no repaired layer, artifact, English quality, runtime, Phase 3 certificate, or superiority claim.
